label: Bright stars
description: All frozen qualifying bright stellar entries within 3000 light-years, plus the Sun.

cutoffPolicy: Every frozen SIMBAD stellar entry no farther than 3000 light-years with compiled Johnson V < 2.70. The SIMBAD stellar hierarchy excludes the integrated-light NGC 1980 cluster row. The aggregate Alpha Centauri system row is replaced by its qualifying A and B components. Acrux uses the Bright Star Catalogue combined V=0.76. Sun is included only as the map origin.
snapshot: J2000.0; SIMBAD TAP source snapshot 2026-09-25, expanded through V=2.69 on 2026-09-30; exact-Hipparcos physical subsets and targeted ranked atmospheric measurements refreshed 2026-10-01; 114 qualifying bright stars plus Sun.
